prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Story: Ericsson +10.7%: Q3 Beat Details and Nokia/Qualcomm/CommScope Read-Through. Related tickers: ERIC, NOK, QCOM, CIEN.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

Why this needs follow-up: ERIC surged 10.71% on a Q3 revenue beat of $5.94B vs $5.59B consensus with 17% EBITA margin vs 14.2% forecast, but the brief lacks analyst reactions, Nokia and CommScope read-throughs, and details on the RAN market commentary that drove the move.

ANSWER EACH QUESTION (run a separate search for each):
- Which sell-side analysts upgraded Ericsson or raised price targets following the October 15 2026 Q3 earnings beat, and what upside did they cite for RAN and enterprise 5G?
- Did Nokia respond to or comment on Ericsson's October 15 2026 Q3 results, and did Nokia shares move in sympathy — and if so by how much?
- What did Ericsson CEO Per Narvinger say specifically about the RAN market outlook and component cost pressures on the October 15 2026 earnings call that investors should note for Qualcomm and Ciena?

Name every stock affected by this story with its move, analyst notes that name winners and losers
(firm, rating, PT), exact figures (deal values, estimates, dates), and the latest status as of the
cutoff. Prefer Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, company releases, filings.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or sub-topic:

## TICKER or Sub-topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## ERIC [Q3 results and stock move]
- Ericsson reported Q3 net sales of SEK59.478 billion, up 5.8% year over year from SEK56.239 billion; adjusted EBITA was SEK10.12 billion versus SEK15.82 billion a year earlier, with a 17.0% adjusted EBITA margin versus 28.1% a year earlier. (Ericsson release, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not stated)
- Adjusted EBITA of SEK10.1 billion exceeded the SEK7.87 billion analyst mean forecast cited by Reuters and the SEK7.93 billion Bloomberg consensus. (Reuters, Oct 15, 2026; Bloomberg, Oct 15, 2026; publication times not stated)
- Ericsson shares rose 10.71% in U.S. trading on Oct 15, 2026; Stockholm shares rose as much as 11%, while Nasdaq pre-market trading showed an approximately 12% gain. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; Bloomberg, Oct 15, 2026; publication times not stated)
- Ericsson said Q3 component costs increased, with higher costs concentrated mainly in the Networks business. (Reuters, Oct 15, 2026; Ericsson earnings-call transcript, Oct 15, 2026)
- Ericsson announced that its Business Enterprise Wireless Solutions portfolio would be moved into other company units, including neutral-host and private-5G products moving into Networks; Cradlepoint assets acquired for $1.1 billion in 2020 would remain in Enterprise. (Light Reading, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not stated)

## ERIC [Analyst notes]
- JPMorgan analysts Sandeep Deshpande and Craig A. McDowell said the results demonstrated strong execution in a difficult market; the available report does not state a rating change or price target. (Bloomberg, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not stated)
- No in-window sell-side upgrade or price-target increase naming a firm, old rating, new rating, old price target, and new price target was identified in the available results.
- The available results contain no quantified analyst estimate for upside specifically tied to RAN or enterprise 5G.

## ERIC [RAN outlook and component costs]
- CEO Per Narvinger said on Oct. 15 that “the RAN market is broadly flat” and that component costs were increasing in the wake of the AI boom. (Ericsson earnings-call transcript, Oct 15, 2026)
- Narvinger said tactical measures, including product substitution and upselling, had mitigated higher component costs in the short term but would not be sufficient over the long term. (Ericsson earnings-call transcript, Oct 15, 2026)
- Ericsson said structural measures would include portfolio optimization, price increases, supply-chain actions, and efficiency improvements. (Ericsson release, Oct 15, 2026)
- Narvinger said higher component costs would create a headwind to gross margin in the following year, while Reuters reported that Ericsson had previously linked rising memory-chip costs to AI demand. (Ericsson release, Oct 15, 2026; Reuters, Oct 15, 2026)
- Ericsson said higher input costs would continue building over coming quarters and that price increases had already begun, with longer-term cost recovery dependent on contract renewals. (Light Reading, Oct 15, 2026; Ericsson earnings-call transcript, Oct 15, 2026)
- The call transcript cited a 10% potential spectrum-efficiency gain from AI RAN and used SpaceX’s reported $8 billion spectrum purchase as an example of a potential $800 million value at that efficiency level. (Yahoo Finance earnings-call highlights, Oct 15, 2026)

## QCOM and CIEN [Read-through]
- The available in-window results linked Ericsson’s component-cost pressure to increased semiconductor demand from AI applications, but did not identify a Qualcomm-specific analyst note, rating action, price target, or stock move. (Reuters, Oct 15, 2026; Ericsson earnings-call transcript, Oct 15, 2026)
- The available in-window results did not identify a Ciena-specific analyst note, rating action, price target, or stock move. (Available sources, Oct. 15–16, 2026)

## NOK [Read-through and stock move]
- The available in-window results did not identify a Nokia statement responding directly to Ericsson’s Oct. 15 Q3 results. (Available sources, Oct. 15–16, 2026)
- Ericsson coverage referenced Nokia’s announcement on Oct. 14 regarding the sale of its campus-5G business, but no transaction value, Nokia share move, analyst rating, or price target was provided in the available in-window results. (RCR Wireless, Oct. 15, 2026)

## Enterprise 5G [Market commentary]
- Ericsson reported Enterprise sales down 10% because of the iconectiv divestment, while organic Enterprise sales increased 1%; adjusted Enterprise gross margin was 50% and adjusted EBITA was negative SEK0.5 billion. (Yahoo Finance earnings-call highlights, Oct. 15, 2026)
- The earnings-call transcript stated that Ericsson was seeing customer momentum in Enterprise 5G private networks, but the available results did not provide a quantified revenue forecast or analyst price-target implication. (Ericsson earnings-call transcript, Oct. 15, 2026)
